$comment: What build-gmsh.sh compiles into wasm/gmsh.wasm, with the licence each is used under and the texts in wasm/licenses/ (ADR 0006, amendment of 2026-10-10). `config` is the word gmsh's configuration string (wasm/build-info.json gmshConfig) uses for it; src/licenses.test.ts checks that every word has an entry, that every text exists, that every licence is allowed inside this separate module, and that nothing names Blossom.

components.name: gmsh
components.note: GPL-2.0-or-later with an exception permitting combination with OpenCASCADE, Netgen, METIS and ParaView; we use it under GPL-3.0-or-later. Dlopen is gmsh's plugin loader switch, no code of its own.

components.name: HXT (gmsh contrib)
components.note: Universite catholique de Louvain; GPL-2.0-or-later with an exception permitting combination with gmsh. The default 3D algorithm.

components.name: TetGen/BR (in gmsh and HXT)
components.note: Hang Si's boundary recovery code, relicensed under gmsh's licence for use in gmsh by agreement between WIAS and GMESH SPRL (gmsh-CREDITS.txt, hxt-CREDITS.txt). Not the AGPL TetGen.

components.name: QuadMeshingTools (gmsh contrib)
components.note: Maxence Reberol; its files say 'See the LICENSE.txt file in the Gmsh root directory'. Compiled in only because gmsh's mesh generation calls it on every run (build-gmsh.sh).

components.name: Eigen (gmsh contrib)
components.note: Header-only; primarily MPL-2.0 without Exhibit B, a few files under the BSD, Apache-2.0 and MINPACK texts copied with it.

components.name: tinyobjloader (gmsh contrib)
components.note: Wavefront OBJ reading; unused by FEA, compiled because gmsh 5.0.0 does not build without it.

components.name: Code by other authors in gmsh's sources
components.license: MIT AND BSD-2-Clause AND LicenseRef-UC-permission AND LicenseRef-public-domain
components.note: Listed with their notices in gmsh-CREDITS.txt: libOL and robin_hood (MIT), picojson and nanoflann (BSD-2-Clause), the AVL tree (the University of California's permission notice, a permissive grant), Shewchuk's robust predicates (public domain).

components.name: OpenCASCADE Technology
components.note: Statically linked into gmsh.wasm (FoundationClasses, ModelingData, ModelingAlgorithms, DataExchange, ApplicationFramework built; the link keeps what gmsh's OCC kernel calls). A second copy of OCCT besides libcascade's; the module stays a separate, replaceable .wasm (ADR 0006 decision 4).

components.name: Emscripten runtime and system libraries (musl, libc++, libc++abi)
components.license: (MIT OR NCSA) AND MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
components.note: The glue (gmsh.mjs) and the libraries every Emscripten C++ build links.
